instruction: Fix `to_csv` so it honours the `delimiter` argument instead of always joining with a comma.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore.py b/datastore.py
--- a/datastore.py
+++ b/datastore.py
@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@
 
 def to_csv(rows, delimiter=","):
     """Serialize a list of rows into a CSV string using ``delimiter``."""
-    return "\n".join(",".join(map(str, row)) for row in rows)
+    return "\n".join(delimiter.join(map(str, row)) for row in rows)
